lines.text: Voyager 1 is now one light-day from Earth. A whole day at light speed!
lines.say: Voyager One is now one light-day from Earth. A whole day, at light speed!

lines.text: NASA says it crossed that line on November 18. Launched in 1977, now about 16 billion miles out.
lines.say: NASA says it crossed that line on November eighteenth. Launched in nineteen seventy-seven, now about sixteen billion miles out.

lines.text: And a message takes 24 hours each way. I can't wait 24 seconds for a text back.
lines.say: And a message takes twenty-four hours each way. I can't wait twenty-four seconds for a text back.

lines.text: Weirdly, it made me feel tiny. Like, what am I even doing?
That's awe. And that tiny feeling is the point.
In 2015, Paul Piff's team had people stand in a grove of towering eucalyptus trees.
lines.say: In twenty fifteen, Paul Piff's team had people stand in a grove of towering eucalyptus trees.

card.title: PIFF ET AL · 2015
card.body: People stood among towering eucalyptus trees.

lines.text: They felt smaller, less self-important, and they acted more generously.

card.title: PIFF ET AL · 2015
card.body: People stood among towering eucalyptus trees.

lines.text: They called it the small self. Less me, more us.
A probe launched in 1977 just made you look up. That counts.
lines.say: A probe launched in nineteen seventy-seven just made you look up. That counts.
